title: Airport Hub Screen Analysis
description: Airports are global hubs where cultures, languages, and lives briefly intersect. Millions of people pass through them each day. On an undisclosed date and at an unknown location, one of these travellers recorded a TV screen for 28 seconds. Watch the video and answer the questions.

questions.label: Determine the exact date and time when the video was recorded.
Identify the airport and the terminal where the TV screen was located.

hint: Translate the video audio/text into English. Review the layout constraints and see which airport terminals match these conditions.
